rules.statement: In an inquiry before an Agrarian Tribunal, the matter need not be established by proof beyond reasonable doubt.
rules.supporting_quote: Where in an inquiry before an Agrarian Tribunal, matter before it need not be established by proof beyond reasonable doubt.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 10 (1) of the Agrarian Development Act, No. 46 of 2000 as amended by Act No. 46 of 2011
